source_prompt:
User task: Do you have capabilities to run at least 5 subagents in parallel right now in the background? Then do it. In order to do
that, I want you to make yourself busy:

• read the codebase
• run the subagent in the background
• read the codebase
Let's see what happens.

Map the codebase relevant to this task. Identify the main packages, entry points, and the shortest list of absolute file paths that matter. Return a compact summary only.
